name: binnacle
description: Binnacle — a dead-simple tree wiki. Cloudflare Worker + D1, managed over MCP, read on the web.

scripts.deploy: echo 'Push to main — Cloudflare Workers Builds auto-deploys. CLI fallback: npx wrangler@latest deploy'
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler@latest d1 migrations apply binnacle --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler@latest d1 migrations apply binnacle --local
